target: Windows - current live client as of 2026-08-06 (1.7.25.39)

areas.name: Live Client and Character Foundation
areas.location_cue: The Windows title screen, character menu, perk screen, and current season panel.
areas.note: Snapshot date: 2026-08-06. Public Test Server content is excluded until it reaches the live client.

levels.1: Check the title screen and news panel before starting a completion session.
levels.2: Use the Windows client at update 1.7.25.39 or later, with Infestations and Burning Springs installed.
levels.3: Record the client version, active season, server type, character level, subscription state, and owned account entitlements. Re-audit this pack after any content update because live availability can change without a new character.

items.label: Reach level 50 before claiming leveled unique rewards

levels.1: Explore, join public activities, and complete repeatable content before cashing in rare one-time rewards.
levels.2: Raise the selected completion character to level 50 before finishing quests that award level-scaled unique gear.
levels.3: Use repeatable events, exploration, Daily Ops, and ordinary quests to reach level 50. Only then complete one-time reward quests so their unique items arrive at maximum level; an online character cannot reload an earlier manual save.

levels.1: Keep leveling after the ordinary perk slots are established.
levels.2: Unlock every legendary-perk slot and finish the chosen account-wide perk-card catalogue.
levels.3: Reach each legendary slot milestone, collect and rank the selected legendary perks with perk coins, acquire every ordinary perk card and animated variant that remains obtainable, and preserve spare loadouts for crafting, combat, exploration, and team play.

levels.1: Treat the transformation as a separate character route because faction access changes.
levels.2: Finish every human-only faction requirement before transforming, then complete the ghoul introduction and ghoul progression on a preserved character plan.
levels.3: Use one character to clear all disguise-sensitive and human-gated faction work first. Complete the ghoul transformation route on that character or a second one, rank every ghoul perk and Glow system unlock, and verify both route-specific records without assuming one state can access every interaction.

save_backup.title: Pause before committing this character
save_backup.why: A faction choice, one-time reward level, or seasonal window can affect permanent completion.
save_backup.detail: Record the current state and, where the service permits it, use a second character for mutually exclusive rewards.

point_of_no_return.title: Clear the branch checklist first
point_of_no_return.why: Online characters cannot reload an earlier manual save.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish both factions' pre-commitment quests and delay leveled one-time rewards until level 50 before crossing the marked commitment step.

save_backup.title: Pause before committing this character
save_backup.why: A faction choice, one-time reward level, or seasonal window can affect permanent completion.
save_backup.detail: Record the current state and, where the service permits it, use a second character for mutually exclusive rewards.

point_of_no_return.title: Clear the branch checklist first
point_of_no_return.why: Online characters cannot reload an earlier manual save.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish both factions' pre-commitment quests and delay leveled one-time rewards until level 50 before crossing the marked commitment step.

areas.name: Faction Choices and Mutually Exclusive Results
areas.location_cue: The Vault 79 faction commitment and the later Brotherhood policy decision.
areas.note: These routes require separate online characters for a permanent archive of every outcome.

levels.1: Keep multiple characters ready before the faction commitment marker.
levels.2: Reach the relevant commitment or final policy prompt after completing every available pre-branch quest.
levels.3: Finish both factions' preparation chains, then commit to Foundation on a dedicated character and complete the raid route. Online saves cannot be rolled back, so do not rely on a manual-save reload.

areas.name: Weapon and Modification Catalogue
areas.location_cue: Weapon benches, plan vendors, event pools, quests, raids, expeditions, Daily Ops, and enemy drops.
areas.note: Current obtainable base and unique weapons are tracked; cut weapons are excluded.

levels.1: Scrap duplicates, inspect faction vendors, and keep unique event or quest rewards.
levels.2: Acquire the matching current weapon or its crafting plan, then raise it to its maximum item level.
levels.3: Obtain or craft a maximum-level example, unlock every applicable non-legacy modification through plans or scrapping, apply and test each configuration, then store one permanent copy. Do not treat removed or developer-only variants as obtainable.

save_backup.title: Pause before committing this character
save_backup.why: A faction choice, one-time reward level, or seasonal window can affect permanent completion.
save_backup.detail: Record the current state and, where the service permits it, use a second character for mutually exclusive rewards.

point_of_no_return.title: Clear the branch checklist first
point_of_no_return.why: Online characters cannot reload an earlier manual save.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish both factions' pre-commitment quests and delay leveled one-time rewards until level 50 before crossing the marked commitment step.

items.label: Discover every marked location in The Forest

items.label: Claim and defend every public workshop

levels.1: Approach workshop icons after clearing their immediate hostiles.
levels.2: Claim every workshop once and complete at least one defense or retake cycle at each.
levels.3: Pay the claim cost, build a resource extractor where available, finish a defense wave, collect one resource cycle, and record the workshop before leaving the server. Ownership resets between sessions.

items.label: Unlock and use every permanent C.A.M.P. system

levels.1: Build gradually while learning plans from exploration and events.
levels.2: Place functional examples of every crafting, resource, defense, power, shelter, display, pet, and ally system currently owned.
levels.3: Construct a valid camp with every functional station and resource type, enter every owned shelter, assign displays and vendors, place a pet and ally where available, save blueprints, and verify camp titles and build challenges register.

areas.name: Fishing and Aquatic Collections
areas.location_cue: Fisherman's Rest, regional fishing waters, bait crafting, and the monthly live rotation.
areas.note: Monthly axolotls are real-time gated and must be audited against the active service calendar.

levels.1: Follow the new radio signal to the anglers' settlement.
levels.2: Start the fishing quest at Fisherman's Rest and unlock the rod, bait, and fishing interface.
levels.3: Finish the full introduction, craft or equip a rod, learn bait production, catch and turn in the requested fish, and confirm fishing dailies and improved-bait rewards are active.

items.label: Catch every permanent fish and size class

levels.1: Try distinct waters, weather, bait, and times rather than repeating one spot.
levels.2: Fill every permanent fish entry and its available size records in the fishing catalogue.
levels.3: Use the required regional water and bait for each species, land the fish without breaking the line, and record every common, uncommon, rare, local-legend, and large-size entry. Preserve special bait for conditions that require it.

items.label: Catch every monthly axolotl when available

levels.1: Check the live monthly notice before choosing a fishing region.
levels.2: Catch the currently active monthly axolotl during its announced calendar window.
levels.3: Use the month's required water and bait, land the axolotl before the rollover, and record it. Missed months are not normally recoverable until Bethesda repeats their schedule, so they remain time-gated rather than ordinary requirements.

save_backup.title: Pause before committing this character
save_backup.why: A faction choice, one-time reward level, or seasonal window can affect permanent completion.
save_backup.detail: Record the current state and, where the service permits it, use a second character for mutually exclusive rewards.

point_of_no_return.title: Clear the branch checklist first
point_of_no_return.why: Online characters cannot reload an earlier manual save.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish both factions' pre-commitment quests and delay leveled one-time rewards until level 50 before crossing the marked commitment step.

areas.name: Nuclear, Bounty, Infestation, and Account Completion
areas.location_cue: Nuclear silos, blast-zone targets, bounty boards, infestation alerts, challenge menus, and endgame vendors.

levels.1: Build a prepared team and keep repair, radiation, and ammunition supplies ready.
levels.2: Use the matching endgame interface and complete the full catalogue for launch from every nuclear silo.
levels.3: Become authorized, obtain a current code or decoded solution, clear each silo, repair its launch systems, and successfully launch once from Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie.

items.label: Complete every nuclear and summoned world boss

levels.1: Build a prepared team and keep repair, radiation, and ammunition supplies ready.
levels.2: Use the matching endgame interface and complete the full catalogue for complete every nuclear and summoned world boss.
levels.3: Trigger each boss with its required blast placement or recall item, finish the public encounter, and repeat until every unique plan and weapon reward has dropped.

items.label: Complete every Grunt Hunt and Head Hunt target

levels.1: Build a prepared team and keep repair, radiation, and ammunition supplies ready.
levels.2: Use the matching endgame interface and complete the full catalogue for complete every grunt hunt and head hunt target.
levels.3: Raise bounty-hunter progression, finish every grunt variant, unlock Head Hunts, and defeat every named target and location variant at least once.

items.label: Clear every Infestation site and boss family

levels.1: Build a prepared team and keep repair, radiation, and ammunition supplies ready.
levels.2: Use the matching endgame interface and complete the full catalogue for clear every infestation site and boss family.
levels.3: Respond to server announcements, search the reduced hotspot, destroy every infestation wave, defeat its possible boss families, and collect each four-star reward type.

items.label: Complete every permanent account and character challenge

levels.1: Build a prepared team and keep repair, radiation, and ammunition supplies ready.
levels.2: Use the matching endgame interface and complete the full catalogue for complete every permanent account and character challenge.
levels.3: Clear every non-seasonal challenge category shown in the menu, including combat, world, survival, social, character, and lifetime records; claim each Atom or title reward.

items.label: Unlock every permanent currency and vendor

levels.1: Build a prepared team and keep repair, radiation, and ammunition supplies ready.
levels.2: Use the matching endgame interface and complete the full catalogue for unlock every permanent currency and vendor.
levels.3: Earn each live currency, meet its vendor, buy every permanent plan or account unlock in that catalogue, and respect wallet limits while rotating vendors.

areas.name: Seasonal, Rotating, and Historical Content
areas.location_cue: The current season menu, official community calendar, Atomic Shop, and time-limited event markers.
areas.note: This section is availability-aware: inactive or retired content is never presented as routine completion.

levels.1: Watch the official calendar instead of waiting on an ordinary server rotation.
levels.2: Participate only while this event or modifier is active on the live schedule.
levels.3: Complete every event objective at its highest tier and repeat until all currently offered plans, apparel, weapons, camp objects, titles, and currencies have been obtained. If inactive, mark it unavailable-now and wait for an official return; do not treat it as normal save cleanup.

items.label: Finish the active season reward track

levels.2: Reach the final unique-reward page before the announced season rollover.
levels.3: Complete daily and weekly challenges, use rerolls deliberately, claim every unique free and entitlement-specific reward you are eligible for, and spend remaining tickets before the season closes. Expired season rewards are historical, not routine save requirements.

items.label: Audit rotating and retired account-store unlocks

levels.3: Claim free account items during their window and document paid or subscription content without presenting it as required gameplay. Never mark an unavailable historical offer as achievable on a normal current save.
